items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: And when I used to go see Louis Armstrong play for, they used to have parties up there... I remember, and if you see that picture, that's just like him.

ctx.x: Yeah, we all tried to check on something.

And Louis Armstrong's picture was in there when he was standing up. He was standing up with a cap on like that and he's got short pants on there. You know they were short pants at them times? Yeah. And he was playing trumpet then. And when I used to go see Louis Armstrong play for, they used to have parties up there, ten cents to go in. And he used to be- The ball and burning the pitch drives and things? No, this was little matinee parties in the yard. Yeah, and they'd sell punch and stuff like that. And he had a…
Well, yeah, I've been asked, how long ago?
